frozen_v2512_equations.constTransportI.H:96,107: base h-based dynamic coefficients are kappa=Cp*mu/Pr and alpha=mu/Pr.
frozen_v2512_equations.perfectGas+hConst: With case Cp constant and perfect-gas R constant, gamma(p,T)=Cp/(Cp-R) is constant at the value above; this is exact for pure-gas cells.

source_interpretation.distinction: The v1 fields alphat/rho, mu/(rho*Pr), and kappaEff/(rho*Cp) are retained as base h-based coefficients. For the case sensibleInternalEnergy T equation, the effective coefficient is alphaEff/rho = CpByCpv*(mu/Pr+alphat)/rho; the corresponding diffusion time is L^2 divided by that coefficient. The eddy/molecular ratio is unchanged by CpByCpv.
source_interpretation.mixture_density_in_coefficients: Both the base h coefficients and alphaEff are divided by the saved native rho field. In alpha.water==0 cells it agrees with p/(R*T) to numerical precision; in the alpha.water<=0.01 selection, the native rho includes the small liquid fraction and is not substituted with pure-air EOS density.
source_interpretation.mixture_qualification: gas_rich_alpha_le_0p01 includes cells with up to 1% liquid and is therefore not asserted to be a strict pure-gas thermodynamic state. strict_pure_gas_alpha_eq_0 contains only cells whose native alpha.water is exactly zero. A gas-thermo gamma evaluated in the gas-rich mask is an exact gas-phase coefficient but only a pure-gas limiting interpretation for any nonzero-alpha mixed cells; no mixed-phase interfacial heat flux is inferred.

scope_limits: Uses saved native alpha.water, p, T, rho, nut, alphat at two checkpoints.
Gas EOS density p/(R*T) and gas mass weighting are evaluated from the native p and T.
Cell-scale diffusion length is the isotropic equivalent cbrt(V); this is a scale estimate, not a resolved heat-flux measurement.
No heat flux, integrated energy balance, interphase transfer, or causal explanation of the temperature history is calculated.
